ios.desc:
Discover a new perspective on your child's imagination with crAion, an innovative app that brings children's drawings to life using advanced AI technology. With crAion, you can dive deep into the world of your child’s creativity and get unique insights into their thoughts and feelings, all through the art they create.

Key Features:

AI-Powered Analysis: An state-of-the-art AI interprets each drawing, revealing the hidden meanings and emotions portrayed in your child's artwork. Understand their development and imagination in a whole new way.
Digital Art Gallery: Store and organize your child's artistic journey in a cloud-based gallery. Relive the joy and progression of their creations anytime and share these precious moments with loved ones.
Family Sharing: crAion makes it easy to share your child’s artwork with family members, creating a shared experience of joy and discovery.
Secure and Private: We prioritize your child's safety and your family's privacy. Rest assured, all data and artwork are securely stored and protected.
Ad-Free Experience: Enjoy uninterrupted exploration of your child's art without the distraction of advertisements.
Regular Updates: We continuously update crAion with new features, enhancements, and content, ensuring your experience is always fresh and engaging.

Whether you’re looking to gain a deeper understanding of your child's inner world, store their art digitally, or simply enjoy their creative expressions, crAion is the perfect companion for any parent. Join us on this beautiful journey into the heart of childhood creativity.

Download crAion now and start exploring the wonders of your child's imagination!

Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/craion-terms

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an iOS app to analyze and interpret kid's drawings with GPT-4

quotes.text:
Hi HN, this is my first post here!

I am a solo developer introducing crAion: a native iOS app that uses the new model 'Vision' by OpenAI to analyze your child's drawings. It interprets what they are representing through their art and how they might be feeling. You can save then the artworks in an organized gallery in the cloud and share them with family and friends.

Looking forward to your feedback :)

App Link: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6473756867
